points.title: 童年与教育
points.description: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李1955年出生于伦敦的一个计算机科学家庭，父母都参与了早期计算机的开发。他在伦敦的伊曼纽尔学校接受基础教育，随后进入牛津大学女王学院学习物理学，于1976年获得学士学位。这段时期培养了他对系统和逻辑的深刻理解，为他后来发明万维网奠定了基础。他的家庭环境和对计算机的早期接触，使他在青少年时期就开始接触编程和系统设计。
points.descriptionEn: Tim Berners-Lee was born in London in 1955 into a family of computer scientists, both of whom were involved in early computer development. He received his primary education at the Emanuel School in London, then went on to study physics at Queen's College, Oxford University, graduating with a bachelor's degree in 1976. This period nurtured his deep understanding of systems and logic, laying the foundation for his later invention of the World Wide Web. His family environment and early exposure to programming and system design allowed him to engage with computing from a young age.

points.title: 欧洲核子研究中心工作
points.description: 1976年，伯纳斯-李短暂加入英国电信公司，但随后于1980年作为独立承包商回到欧洲核子研究中心(CERN)工作。在这里，他面临一个实际问题：如何让分散在世界各地的科学家方便地共享信息。他开发了ENQUIRE系统，这是一个基于超文本的个人信息管理工具，允许用户通过链接连接不同的文档。这个项目虽然未公开发布，但包含了万维网的核心概念，如链接和共享信息。这段经历让他深刻理解了信息共享的复杂性和必要性。
points.descriptionEn: In 1976, Berners-Lee briefly joined British Telecom, but then returned to CERN as an independent contractor in 1980. There, he faced a practical problem: how to enable scientists scattered worldwide to easily share information. He developed the ENQUIRE system, a hypertext-based personal information management tool that allowed users to connect different documents through links. Although this project was never publicly released, it contained the core concepts of the World Wide Web, such as linking and information sharing. This experience gave him a deep understanding of the complexity and necessity of information sharing.

points.title: 发明万维网
points.titleEn: Invention of the World Wide Web
points.description: 1989年3月，伯纳斯-李向CERN提交了一份题为'信息管理：一个提案'的备忘录，提出了一个基于超文本的全球信息系统。1990年，他与罗伯特·卡里奥合作开发了第一个网页浏览器和网页编辑器。1991年8月6日，世界上第一个网站info.cern.ch上线，标志着万维网的正式诞生。他设计了HTTP协议、HTML语言和URL系统，这三个技术构成了万维网的基础。伯纳斯-李坚持免费开放这些技术，没有申请专利，确保了万维网的快速普及和全球发展。
points.descriptionEn: In March 1989, Berners-Lee submitted a memorandum titled 'Information Management: A Proposal' to CERN, outlining a global hypertext-based information system. In 1990, he collaborated with Robert Cailliau to develop the first web browser and web editor. On August 6, 1991, the world's first website info.cern.ch went online, marking the official birth of the World Wide Web. He designed the HTTP protocol, HTML language, and URL system, which formed the technical foundation of the web. Berners-Lee insisted on making these technologies freely available without patents, ensuring the rapid proliferation and global development of the World Wide Web.

points.title: 万维网联盟领导
points.titleEn: Leading the World Wide Web Consortium
points.description: 1994年，伯纳斯-李在麻省理工学院(MIT)创立了万维网联盟(W3C)，担任主任一职。在W3C的领导下，他致力于制定和推广开放的网络标准，确保万维网的互操作性和长期发展。他推动了HTML、XML、CSS等关键标准的制定，并积极倡导网络中立性和开放性。这一时期，他获得了多项荣誉，包括2004年被英国女王伊丽莎白二世授予爵位，以及2012年获得英国政府授予的互联网之父称号。他同时担任麻省理工学院计算机科学和人工智能实验室(CSAIL)的教授，继续研究网络技术的未来发展。
points.descriptionEn: In 1994, Berners-Lee founded the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) at MIT and served as its director. Under his leadership, he worked to develop and promote open web standards, ensuring the interoperability and long-term development of the web. He drove the development of key standards such as HTML, XML, and CSS, and actively advocated for network neutrality and openness. During this period, he received numerous honors, including being knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 2004 and being named 'Father of the Internet' by the British government in 2012. He also served as a professor at MIT's Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (CSAIL), continuing to research the future development of web technologies.

points.title: 互联网基金会与未来愿景
points.description: 2016年，伯纳斯-李创立了万维网基金会(Web Foundation)，致力于确保所有人都能开放、自由、安全地使用网络。他成为网络伦理的积极倡导者，对当前互联网面临的隐私问题、虚假信息和数据垄断表示担忧。他提出了'网络契约'倡议，呼吁政府、公司和公民共同努力，创造一个更加公平、开放和安全的网络环境。尽管已年过六旬，他仍然活跃在技术前沿，继续推动网络技术的创新和发展，并致力于解决互联网带来的社会挑战。
points.descriptionEn: In 2016, Berners-Lee founded the Web Foundation, dedicated to ensuring that everyone can access the web openly, freely, and safely. He became an active advocate for web ethics, expressing concerns about privacy issues, misinformation, and data monopolies plaguing the current internet. He proposed the 'Contract for the Web' initiative, calling on governments, companies, and citizens to work together to create a more fair, open, and secure web environment. Despite being in his sixties, he remains active at the forefront of technology, continuing to drive innovation in web technology and addressing the social challenges brought by the internet.

supporter.zh: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李被誉为互联网之父，他的贡献彻底改变了人类信息共享和交流的方式。他创造万维网时坚持免费开放的原则，没有申请专利，确保了技术的快速普及和全球发展。他领导的万维网联盟制定了开放标准，促进了互联网的互操作性。如今，数十亿人能够自由访问信息，这一成就很大程度上归功于他的远见和无私奉献。他不仅改变了技术世界，也深刻影响了社会、经济和政治格局。
supporter.en: Tim Berners-Lee is hailed as the father of the internet, and his contributions have completely transformed how humanity shares information and communicates. He insisted on making the World Wide Web freely available without patents, ensuring rapid proliferation and global development. Through the World Wide Web Consortium, he established open standards that promoted interoperability. Today, billions of people can freely access information, an achievement largely due to his vision and selfless dedication. He not only changed the technological world but also profoundly influenced social, economic, and political landscapes.

critic.zh: 批评者认为伯纳斯-李对互联网的愿景过于理想化，未能预见和控制互联网带来的负面问题。他最初设计的万维网缺乏安全机制，导致如今网络诈骗、隐私泄露和虚假信息泛滥。有人批评他未能有效应对大型科技公司的垄断和数据滥用问题，尽管他后来成立了万维网基金会试图解决这些问题。此外，他的技术决策如HTML的设计也被认为存在局限性，后来需要不断修补和扩展。批评者认为，作为互联网的创造者，他本应在早期就更多地考虑伦理和社会影响。
critic.en: Critics argue that Berners-Lee's vision for the internet was overly idealistic and failed to anticipate and control the negative issues that have emerged. The original World Wide Web he designed lacked security mechanisms, leading to today's problems with cybercrime, privacy breaches, and misinformation. Some criticize him for not effectively addressing the monopolies and data abuses by big tech companies, despite later founding the Web Foundation to address these issues. Additionally, his technical decisions, such as the design of HTML, are seen as having limitations that required constant patching and expansion. Critics believe that as the creator of the internet, he should have considered ethical and social impacts more from the beginning.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，伯纳斯-李已成为数字时代的标志性人物，象征着互联网的开放精神。他的故事常被讲述为技术理想主义的典范——一位科学家出于纯粹的信息共享愿望创造了改变世界的技术。在学术界，他被研究为技术创新与社会变革关系的典型案例。随着互联网发展，他的形象也从单纯的'技术发明者'演变为'数字伦理倡导者'，反映了人们对互联网从技术工具向社会基础设施转变的认识。他的经历也体现了个人创新如何能够重塑全球信息生态的深远影响。
objective.en: From historical and cultural perspectives, Berners-Lee has become an iconic figure of the digital age, symbolizing the open spirit of the internet. His story is often told as an exemplar of technological idealism—a scientist who created world-changing technology out of pure desire for information sharing. In academia, he is studied as a典型案例 of the relationship between technological innovation and social change. As the internet has evolved, his image has transformed from a mere 'technical inventor' to an 'advocate for digital ethics,' reflecting society's growing understanding of the internet's shift from a technical tool to social infrastructure. His experience also illustrates the profound impact individual innovation can have on reshaping the global information ecosystem.

self.zh: 万维网不是为了让人们赚钱而设计的，它是为了让人们共享信息而设计的。
self.en: The Web was not designed to make people money. It was designed to share information.

others.zh: 他创造了互联网，却没有从中获利一美分，这可能是历史上最伟大的慈善行为。
others.en: He created the internet and didn't make a dime from it. That might be the greatest act of charity in history.
